verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents its own crawl capability, which recursively crawls an entire website and returns content from every page. The evidence never mentions a breadth-first traversal strategy or a configurable maximum page limit, so only the core deep-crawl part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented breadth-first crawl strategy, documented configurable max page/limit parameter, independent or hands-on corroboration of crawl behavior at scale.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can run a deep crawl using a breadth-first strategy with a configurable maximum page limit

citations.quote: Crawl an entire website and get content from all pages.
Rastrea recursivamente un sitio web y obtén contenido de cada página
